title: Nine Months of Stubbornness
subtitle: 态度与看法 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 态度与看法（做人与做事·品格与态度）
meta: 主题语境：态度与看法（做人与做事·品格与态度）　|　核心词汇：attitude　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 attitude 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 my brother developed ① an attitude which my grandmother said he had not invented, only rented. The ② attitude, meaning the manner and not the opinion, lasted nine months and cost him a job; an attitude, she said, is a position you take up before you know what the argument is. She said the argument turned out to be about nothing.

Every ③ attitude in that house was caught, not taught, and she said that was the trouble with houses. Their ④ attitude — the one the headmaster wrote about — was described in nine words, none of them kind; an attitude, my father said, is the only thing about a person that other people can see and they cannot. He said that is why it is never mentioned at home.

My mother said the word had changed by 1980 and meant ⑤ an attitude of mind, by which she meant a way of standing towards things. The ⑥ attitude, meaning the inner thing and not the outward manner, is nine parts habit and one part decision; an attitude, she said, is the only possession you cannot lose on purpose. She said you can only lose it by accident.

By 1977 the ⑦ attitude had softened, which he denied, and my grandmother said denial was part of it. The ⑧ attitude of the photograph, she said, is the only true record, because nobody arranges their shoulders; an attitude, my father said, is either a way of thinking or a way of standing, and the word has always served both. He said the word is older than either.

The ⑨ attitude I remember is the one he had at seventeen, which he now calls a phase and I call a decade. An ⑩ attitude, my mother said in 1984, is the only thing you can change without anybody noticing and keep without anybody asking; every attitude, she said, is an argument you have had once and now live inside. She said the rent on it is never finished.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 态度（一种具体的态度）
B. n. 态度（指举止、做派，与看法相对）
C. n. 态度（指校长写下的那一种）
D. 固定搭配：develop an attitude 形成一种态度；闹情绪
E. 固定搭配：an attitude of mind 心态
F. n. 态度（指内心的、看不见的那种）
G. n. 姿态；姿势（身体上的）
H. n. 态度（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: an attitude which my grandmother said
The attitude, meaning the manner and not the opinion
The attitude, meaning the inner thing
An attitude, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: develop an attitude 意为“形成一种态度、闹情绪”，1973 年弟弟生出了一种态度，祖母说他没有发明它，只是租来的。
attitude 指“举止、做派”，与看法相对，这种态度持续了九个月，让他丢了一份工作。
attitude 为抽象总称，泛指“态度这种东西”，那屋里每一种态度都是染上的，不是教出来的。
attitude 指校长写下的那一种，他们的态度被用九个词描述出来，没有一个词是善意的。
an attitude of mind 意为“心态”，母亲说这个词到 1980 年已经变了意思，指的是一种面向事物的站法。
attitude 指“内心的那种东西”，与外露的举止相对，是九分习惯加一分决定。
attitude 意为“一种具体的态度”，到 1977 年那种态度软化了，他本人否认，祖母说否认也是它的一部分。
attitude 意为“姿态、姿势”，照片上的姿态是唯一真实的记录，因为没有谁会去摆布自己的肩膀。
attitude 意为“一种具体的态度”，我记得的是他十七岁时那一种，他现在管它叫一个阶段，我管它叫十年。
attitude 为抽象总称，母亲说态度是唯一你可以改掉而没人察觉、留着而没人过问的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年弟弟形成了一种态度，祖母说他没有发明它，只是租来的。（develop an attitude）
那种态度，指的是举止而不是看法，持续了九个月，让他丢了一份工作。（attitude）
那屋里每一种态度都是染上的，不是教出来的，她说那就是房子的毛病。（attitude）
他们那种态度，也就是校长写下的那一种，被用九个词描述出来，没有一个词是善意的。（attitude）
母亲说的是另一种东西：心态，也就是一种面向事物的站法。（an attitude of mind）
1984 年母亲说，态度是唯一你可以改掉而没人察觉、留着而没人过问的东西。（attitude）

The attitude, meaning the manner and not the opinion, lasted nine months and cost him a job.
Every attitude in that house was caught, not taught, and she said that was the trouble with houses.
Their attitude, the one the headmaster wrote about, was described in nine words, none of them kind.
My mother meant an attitude of mind, by which she meant a way of standing towards things.
An attitude, my mother said in 1984, is the only thing you can change without anybody noticing and keep without anybody asking.
